evidenceBoundary.direct: Named compiled calls, selected virtual assignment/initialization claims and narrowly witnessed incoming-instance closed-data field reads. Field reads authenticate receiver ownership separately from mere displacement matching; they do not establish later call arguments or live values. A checked false Boolean guard also reaches a typed enum literal through a complete EAX-to-RET epilogue. Selected bool/byte Data reads authenticate a complete byte MOV or unsigned byte MOVZX, register/base/displacement and incoming-instance ownership; they do not normalize or evaluate the byte. An explicit byte-argument mode also joins the owned Data byte to the sole selected bool/byte parameter of a nongeneric reference instance method returning void/bool. An owned instance byte-store profile follows complete incoming-this/argument aliases through the selected false Boolean guard to a named instance field. An explicit normal-forward-jump profile follows only complete local EB/E9 instructions whose byte-derived targets match the decoded text and a selected instruction boundary. Conditional branches retain fallthrough; other paths and loops are not explored. An explicit closed-generic-reference-field profile independently proves a full reference read and does not admit generic sink argument forwarding. Register-only BT decoding preserves operand direction, width, complete boundaries and the fact that only flags are written. A separate owned-byte return profile proves the selected false Boolean guard and non-null Data fallthrough return alwaysNext through AL with an unchanged complete epilogue.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: These calls describe compiled paths. Branch selection, IFix execution and actual delivery require separate evidence. Explicit local-path selection checks complete original instruction boundaries and local branch edges, while preserving the existing incoming-instance, field, ABI and clobber proofs. It does not establish branch feasibility, live selection or callee return.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live target selection, evaluated values, keys, writes, server acceptance and whole Buff behavior. Call presence does not prove that a particular stored field supplies a call argument. Concrete reference suffixes establish only the selected closed Data slot. AI target-group updates, shorter SpellInfliction, CharHurtAnim, Ignite text events, projectile launch and lock-on recovery retain separate live branch/value/entity/effect gaps. Generic event Dispatch presence does not identify its instantiated event payload. Global creation/finish, lifetime arithmetic, chosen Buff handles, Switch Option selection/iteration and conditional mask outcomes remain open even when owned configuration fields and selected sink arguments are proved. The custom Switch policy caller use and current Data assignment, runtime duration values, early-finish reason, weapon receiver and rendering effects remain separate obligations.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: A closedReferenceLayout claim independently proves the selected sole generic reference slot with either an instance-fieldless concrete subclass or an explicitly checked complete contiguous concrete suffix. Selected static declarations do not consume instance space. Closed generic suffix references authenticate the selected reference-class definition and complete closed argument identity independently of argument storage; generic value types remain excluded. This does not claim a field read, runtime type, field value or use at a sink.
